title: The note
goals: Reach the end of the path.
starting_code:
# One move in this program is wrong. Find it and fix it!
wizard.move_left()
wizard.move_left()
wizard.move_down()
wizard.move_right()
hints: Read the moves one by one and see where they take you.
The last move takes you the wrong way.
intro: I wrote a program on the way up the hill to walk the next bit of path. I think one of its moves is wrong. You can read my note, which programmers call a comment.
outro: You fixed it! Reading code is just as important as writing it.
learned: Now you know about notes, which programmers call comments.
